strategy.offer: Wood flooring systems, matching accessories, surface-treatment options, technical guidance, and digital tools for selecting, ordering, installing, and maintaining floors.
strategy.customers: Homeowners, retailers, trade buyers, architects, designers, installers, and project developers in residential, commercial, and sports venues worldwide.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects growth through durable, attractive, sustainably made floors, broad design choice, close customer relationships, and continued investment in production and innovation.
strategy.resources: Long wood-processing know-how, manufacturing sites, sales offices, partner network, certified sourcing systems, and specialised technical, design, and digital capabilities.
strategy.direction: It is moving toward more digital customer journeys, ongoing product and process innovation, wider international reach, and more fully certified sustainable sourcing.
